verdict.rationale: Superhuman for Teams documents shared conversation state across teammates. Read statuses are shared across the team, and reply indicators show when a teammate is replying, which prevents collisions on the same thread. The evidence never describes a true shared inbox, shared account, or team-channel model where a team works one inbox together. Missing for 10: documented shared inbox/shared account support, team channels or assignment of conversations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the team features.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Team Read Statuses: Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.
Team Reply Indicators: See when your team is replying, so you can avoid double work and embarrassing collisions.
